newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index dips.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index dips.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was down 1.39 points, or 1.79 percent at 76.08, after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index fell a provisional 78.36 points to 3,525.84.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 10.23 percent from 9.45 percent on Tuesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
